label: PLANET GS-4210-8P2S (hardware version 3)
description: PLANET GS-4210-8P2S managed Gigabit PoE+ switch (hardware version 3): 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T 802.3af/at PoE+ RJ45 (30 W a port), 2x 100/1000BASE-X SFP uplinks, 140 W PoE budget at 25 C and 120 W at 50 C, 20 Gbps non-blocking fabric, 14.88 Mpps, fanless metal case.

poe.note: 140 W max at 25 degrees C and 120 W max at 50 degrees C. 802.3af/802.3at PSE, end-span, 1/2(+) 3/6(-), 30 W max a port at 56 V DC. The datasheet budgets 8 PDs at 7 W, 5 at 15.4 W and 5 at 30 W, so 140 W is the ceiling rather than 8 x 30 W.

fabric.note: 20 Gbps non-blocking switch fabric, 14.88 Mpps at 64 bytes, 8K MAC table, 4.1 Mbit shared buffer, 10K jumbo frames.

notes: Hardware version 3 datasheet. Ports 1-8 are copper PoE+, 9-10 are SFP cages, then the console. The console is a single RS-232-to-RJ45 port at 115200 8-N-1 that drops into the CLI, so cli is declared. No PoE on the SFP cages. 280 x 180 x 44 mm, 1.6 kg, fanless, 170 W max with full PoE load. Discrepancy: the GS-4210 Series Quick Installation Guide v1.5 says the console interface is not available on the GS-4210-8P2S, which holds for the hardware v1/v2 board; the current hardware v3 datasheet lists the RJ45 console port and that is what is modelled.
